entities.name: Query catalase-peroxidase
observations: 737-aa sequence; close Swiss-Prot homologs (72.5–74.5% identity, 98.4–98.9% query coverage) are annotated as bifunctional catalase-peroxidases.
Query Pfam scan detects two peroxidase domains: PF00141 at residues 94–399 and 407–711.
Reference annotations indicate heme b dependence, hydrogen-peroxide breakdown and broad-spectrum peroxidase activity; these are homology-based assignments for the query.
